description: Wuppertal ATOM Feed Trinkwasserbrunnen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis-rest.nrw.de. The ATOM Feed download service for drinking water fountains in Wuppertal provides a data set for download, which (as of 04/2025) includes 5 publicly accessible drinking water fountains in the Wuppertal city area, modelled as point geometries by the city of Wuppertal in the summer. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wuppertal ATOM Feed drinking water well" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, Wuppertal, Teilzwilling, Trinkbrunnennetz, DigiTal Zwilling, smart.wuppertal. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ATOM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
